description: This header defines template classes and functions for managing plugin interfaces, including reference management, interface creation, and builder pattern for plugin interface configuration within the WPEFramework plugin system.

classes.name: PluginInterfaceRef
classes.description: A smart reference wrapper for plugin interface pointers, managing reference counting and move semantics.

classes.name: PluginInterfaceBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring and creating plugin interface instances with specified parameters.

methods.name: createInterface
methods.description: Creates and returns a plugin interface instance based on the builder's configuration.

methods.name: make_unique
methods.description: A utility function to create a std::unique_ptr for a given type with forwarded arguments.
